cohort: A multicentre cohort of 11,271 women of reproductive age in Ukraine who achieved singleton pregnancy by ART between January 1st, 2017, and December 31st, 2021, was studied.
finding: Endometriosis and ART use are independently associated with increased risks of preterm birth, antepartum haemorrhage, placenta praevia, and planned birth.
mod_finding: Women with endometriosis had higher risks of Caesarean section and planned birth.
